contract.intent: Amend flow-control-spec v2 to v3 — closure-by-transfer: a human-gated decision closes a round/task whose gate is unmet by re-scoping and transferring the remaining ACs to the next round/task (inherited verbatim). Produces a COMPLETE superseding artifact.
acceptanceCriteria: flow-control-spec-v3.md artifact exists — complete doc = v2 + closure-by-transfer
The mechanism: look-back → gate unmet + remaining work → human decision → gate re-scope (amendment record) → ACs transfer verbatim → close (completed + gate②) → next spawns carrying the goal
Never automatic; the closure is a gated human decision, recorded honestly
Same mechanism at task level (scope shifts between tasks/rounds)
v3 locked (type=spec); v2 gets a superseded event
requiredInputs: User decision: move the build to the next round (closure-by-transfer)
